briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Canva, 17 November 2026

**Scope:** Developments from roughly 18 October to 17 November 2026, based only on the search results provided. Every fact is cited to its source URL.

## What changed

**Restructuring and layoffs**
- Canva is cutting about 22% of its workforce, or 1,271 employees, as it flattens the org chart and consolidates teams (https://www.computerworld.com/article/3816579/tech-layoffs-this-year-a-timeline.html; https://m.economictimes.com/news/international/world-news/canva-layoffs-2026-meet-ceo-melanie-perkins-who-plans-to-give-away-80-of-her-billion-dollar-fortune-as-1271-jobs-are-cut/articleshow/135575689.cms).
- The company is merging its product, growth and platform teams and aims to reduce "subspecialisation," so remaining staff may take on broader responsibilities (https://tech.yahoo.com/general/breaking-news/article/tech-layoffs-tracker-2026-all-the-job-losses-across-canva-squarespace-amazon-microsoft-apple-meta-and-others-141507340.html).
- CEO Melanie Perkins said "small changes won't be enough" and that Canva needs to "re-found" itself around small, empowered teams (https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-04/canva-restructure-job-losses/107344304).
- Departing staff get at least six months' salary plus support. Severance includes a free year of LinkedIn Premium and keeping company MacBooks. A new fund offers US$10,000 grants to start a business or pursue a community project (https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-04/canva-restructure-job-losses/107344304; https://m.economictimes.com/news/international/world-news/canva-layoffs-2026-meet-ceo-melanie-perkins-who-plans-to-give-away-80-of-her-billion-dollar-fortune-as-1271-jobs-are-cut/articleshow/135575689.cms).
- Staff were given the day off, with further restructuring details to come at a company meeting (https://mashable.com/tech/canva-mass-layoffs-ai-restructuring).
- Before the cuts, a Capital Brief report said Canva could announce more redundancies or a hiring freeze in November amid a revised revenue growth outlook. Canva had not confirmed this (https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137).
- Capital Brief also reported previously unreported finance-division cuts of 32 roles in January (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).

**AI and partnerships**
- Canva expanded its OpenAI deal, gaining broader access to GPT-6 Astra and GPT-5.6. The two companies will work on making these models cheaper to run, though no savings or costs were disclosed. The deal came days after Canva launched its second in-house AI model (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).
- OpenAI already powers Canva Code, which builds interactive designs, websites and apps from text descriptions (same source).

**Deals**
- A wire report says a company has agreed to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4 billion, citing people familiar with the matter, with closing expected next quarter (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced).
- **Caution:** The excerpt does not name Canva. Do not treat this as a Canva deal until it is confirmed.

**Hires:** No hiring announcements were found in the results. The only hiring-related item is the reported possible freeze (above).

**Background (outside the 30-day window)**
- Canva is privately held, headquartered in Surry Hills, NSW, and was founded in 2012 (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/wafeqPWRLzYp).
- Recent acquisitions listed include Ortto (April 2026), SimTheory (April 2026), and Doohly, reported at US$30M (March 2026) (same source).

## Open questions

1. With product, growth and platform teams merging and roles broadening, who now owns decisions on our account and roadmap, and which contacts have changed?
2. Given the reported revised revenue outlook and possible hiring freeze, how does this affect your plans and timing for the next 12 months?
3. Is Canva involved in the reported Globex acquisition, and if so, could it affect our contract, data-handling terms, or delivery timeline?
